selection.data: Reuse exactly the old 12 Train-main sequences and uniform candidate row indices, now reading their labels. No new sampling or feature extraction.
selection.objective: Maximize mean of ordinary/high-density group IoU estimates. Expand each sequence's sampled candidate confusion counts by N/k, add exact fixed Proposal rejects, divide by the full sequence event count, then average equally across sequences within each group. These are sample estimates, not full-stream accuracy.
selection.tie_breaks: Fewer teacher-correct events made wrong (density/sequence balanced), lower balanced teacher-margin MSE, lower sample equivalent AC, deterministic encoder key. No tunable weighted sum of objectives.
selection.task_rescore: Select by the task objective from exactly the previous MSE search's candidate pool. This isolates selection objective from search-budget changes.
selection.task: Same objective, additionally run bounded coordinate search from the best rescored point and stagewise seed using the unchanged coarse/refinement ranges. Archive every candidate.
selection.task_matched_ac: Best task objective among candidates with equivalent synaptic AC on the fixed calibration sample <= the same-stage/same-T uncalibrated value. A second coordinate path searches within that budget. This calibration constraint is not a guarantee on Dev AC or a runtime guard.
selection.freeze: All six selections and source identities are saved before any new Dev evaluation. Never change calibration after seeing Dev results. No optimizer, backpropagation, weight updates or decision-threshold tuning.

encoding: Import the unchanged h2pro_calibration_v1 Encoder/forward, with one shared integer theta/m0 per hidden layer, original integer weights/scales/uint8 quantizers, and separately counted post-accumulation decode scaling.
evaluation: Replay ANN and five modes at each r1/r2 and T=4/8/16 on all ten closed-prefix Train-dev sequences. Explicit binary spike additions must match the count reference exactly. No Validation/Test access.
limitations: Hybrid layer-serial Refiner conversion; Proposal and first-layer continuous MAC remain. T is coding steps, not milliseconds. MAC/AC are neural arithmetic counts, not full pipeline cost or measured energy. This is supervised calibration, not a novel network or a label-free method.
